questions.question: Rohit made a profit of 22% when he sold a jacket for ₹7,930. Find the cost price of the jacket.

15 kg of superior quality of wheat is mixed with 5 kg of inferior quality of wheat. The price of superior quality and inferior quality wheat is ₹80 and ₹60, respectively. Find the average price per kg of the mixture.
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Weight of superior quality wheat (Wₛ) = 15 kg

Weight of inferior quality wheat (Wᵢ) = 5 kg

Price of superior quality wheat (Pₛ) = ₹80 per kg

Price of inferior quality wheat (Pᵢ) = ₹60 per kg

**Formula used:**

Average price per kg of the mixture = dfrac{(W_s times P_s) + (W_i times P_i)}{W_s + W_i}

**Calculation:**

Average price per kg of the mixture = dfrac{(15 times 80) + (5 times 60)}{15 + 5}

⇒ Average price per kg of the mixture = dfrac{1200 + 300}{20}

⇒ Average price per kg of the mixture = dfrac{1500}{20}

⇒ Average price per kg of the mixture = 75

**∴ The correct answer is option (4).**

questions.solution:

Rate of Interest (r) = 3% per year

questions.question: A cylindrical vessel of height 14 cm has outer and inner radii 14 cm and 10 cm, respectively. It is to be filled by transferring water in it by using a small cylinder of height 7 cm and outer and inner radii 7 cm and 5 cm, respectively. What will be the unfilled height of the big vessel after transferring water 6 times by using the smaller cylinder? (Use pi = (22)/(7) )
questions.solution:
**Given:**

H = 14 cm, R = 14 cm, r = 10 cm

h = 7 cm, R' = 7 cm, r' = 5 cm

Number of transfer = 6 times

**Formula used:**

Volume of a cylinder = π × radius² × height

**Calculation:**

Volume of the big vessel:

⇒ π × (R² - r²) × H = ⇒ π × (142 - 102) × 14 = 1344π

Volume of the small cylinder (for one transfer):

⇒ π × (R'² - r'²) × h = π × (72 - 52) × 7 = 168π

Total volume transferred (for 6 transfers):

⇒ 6 × 168π = 1008π

Unfilled volume of the big vessel:

⇒ 1344π - 1008π = 336π

Unfilled height of the big vessel:

⇒ Volume / (π × (R² - r²))

⇒ (336π) / (96π)

⇒ 336 / 96

⇒ 3.5 cm

**∴ The correct answer is option (2).**

questions.question: The average age of a husband and wife, and their child 3 years ago, was 27 years, and that of the wife and the child 5 years ago was 20 years. The present age of the husband is:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Average age (Husband + Wife + Child) 3 years ago = 27 years

Average age (Wife + Child) 5 years ago = 20 years

**Calculation:**

Total age (H + W + C) 3 years ago = 27 × 3 = 81 years

Present total age (H + W + C) = 81 + (3 × 3) = 81 + 9 = 90 years

Total age (W + C) 5 years ago = 20 × 2 = 40 years

Present total age (W + C) = 40 + (2 × 5) = 40 + 10 = 50 years

Present age of Husband (H) = Present total age (H + W + C) - Present total age (W + C)

⇒ H = 90 - 50

⇒ H = 40 years

**∴ The present age of the husband is 40 years.**

questions.question: Akshay wants to buy a 6 m wide cloth to make a conical tent having a radius of 12 m and height of 35 m. How many metres of cloth does he need to buy? Take pi = (22)/(7) Note: Round off the decimals to the nearest whole number.
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Cloth width = 6 m

Tent radius (r) = 12 m

Tent height (h) = 35 m

**Formula Used:**

Slant height of cone (l) = √(r² + h²)

Curved surface area of cone = π × r × l

Length of cloth = Curved surface area / Cloth width

**Calculation:**

Slant height (l) = √(12² + 35²)

l = √(144 + 1225)

l = √1369 ⇒ l = 37 m

Curved surface area = (22/7) × 12 × 37

Curved surface area = 9768 / 7 ≈ 1395.43 m²

Length of cloth = 1395.43 / 6

⇒ Length of cloth ≈ 232.57 m

Rounding off to the nearest whole number, length of cloth ≈ 233 m

**∴ Akshay needs to buy approximately 233 metres of cloth.**

questions.question: The average age of a class of 39 students is 15 years. If the age of the teacher be included, then the average increases by 3 months. Find the age of the teacher.
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Age of Teacher = Initial Average + (New Total Count × Increase in Average)

Initial Average = 15 years

New Total Count (including teacher) = 39 + 1 = 40

Increase = 3 months = 3/12 = 0.25 years

Teacher's Age = 15 + (40 × 0.25) = 15 + 10 = 25 years

**∴ The correct answer is 25 years.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Number of students = 39

Average age of students = 15 years

Increase in average = 3 months

**Formula Used:**

Total Age = Average Age × Number of People

 39 Students Avg = 15 yrs Teacher 
• New Average = 15 years 3 months 
 +3 months Total People = 40 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Total age of 39 students = 39 × 15 = 585 years

⇒ New number of people = 39 + 1 = 40

⇒ New average = 15 years + 3 months = 15 years + (3/12) years = 15.25 years

⇒ Total age of 40 people = 40 × 15.25 = 610 years

⇒ Age of Teacher = Total age of 40 people − Total age of 39 students

⇒ Age of Teacher = 610 − 585 = 25 years

**∴ The correct answer is 25 years.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Weighted Average Formula

When two groups are combined, the new average A = (n₁×A₁ + n₂×A₂) ÷ (n₁ + n₂), where n is the number of items and A is the average.

Average of Consecutive Numbers

For any Arithmetic Progression (A.P.), the average is always (First Term + Last Term) ÷ 2.

Net Change in Average

If a person of age X is replaced by a person of age Y and the average of 'n' people changes by 'd', then Y = X + (n × d).

questions.question: The sum of length and breadth of a rectangle is 68 m and the ratio of length and breadth is 11:23. What is the area of the rectangle (in m²)?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

The sum of length and breadth of a rectangle is 68 m and the ratio of length and breadth is 11:23.

**Formula used:**

Let the length be 11x and the breadth be 23x. Then, 11x + 23x = 68.

**Calculation:**

11x + 23x = 68

⇒ 34x = 68

⇒ x = 2

Length = 11x = 11 × 2 = 22 m

Breadth = 23x = 23 × 2 = 46 m

Area = Length × Breadth = 22 × 46

⇒ Area = 1012 m²

**∴ The correct answer is option (4).**

S.I. = (P × R × T) / 100

**Calculation:**

Let capital = C.

Remaining capital fraction = 1 - 1/4 - 1/5 = 11/20

Interest = (1/4C × 10 × 1)/100 + (1/5C × 20 × 1)/100 + (11/20C × 30 × 1)/100

⇒ 3220 = C/40 + C/25 + 33C/200

⇒ 3220 = (5C + 8C + 33C) / 200

⇒ 3220 × 200 = 46C

⇒ C = 14000

**∴ The capital is ₹14,000.**

questions.question: If p is directly proportional to q and is p = 7 when q = 6, then what is the value of p when q = 21?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

p is directly proportional to q

p = 7 when q = 6

**Formula used:**

p = kq (where k is the constant of proportionality)

**Calculation:**

7 = k × 6

⇒ k = 7/6

When q = 21, p = k × 21

p = (7/6) × 21

⇒ p = 24.5

**∴ The correct answer is option (2).**

questions.question: The average age of 40 students in a class is 12 years. The average age of the students increased by 4 months due to 20 new admissions in the class. The average age of the newly admitted students is:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

n₁ = 40, avg₁ = 12 years

n₂ = 20, increase in avg = 4/12 years

avgₙₑw = 12 + 1/3 = 37/3 years

**Calculation:**

Initial total age = 40 × 12 = 480 years

New total age = (40 + 20) × 37/3 = 60 × 37/3 = 740 years

Age of new students = 740 - 480 = 260 years

Average age of new students = 260 / 20 = 13 years

**∴ Average age of new students = 13 years.**

questions.question: Maria buys a dress for ₹3,000. She could not decide between a discount of 35% and three successive discounts of 20%, 10% and 5%. The difference between both discounts (in ₹) is:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Cost Price = ₹3000

Discount Option 1 = 35%

Discount Option 2 = 20%, 10%, and 5% successive

**Calculation:**

Discount 1 Amount = 3000 × (35/100) = 3000 × 0.35 = ₹1050

Price after 1st discount = 3000 - (3000 × 20/100) = 3000 - 600 = ₹2400

Price after 2nd discount = 2400 - (2400 × 10/100) = 2400 - 240 = ₹2160

Price after 3rd discount = 2160 - (2160 × 5/100) = 2160 - 108 = ₹2052

Total discount 2 amount = 3000 - 2052 = ₹948

Difference between discounts = Discount 1 Amount - Total discount 2 amount = 1050 - 948 = ₹102

**∴ The difference between both discounts is ₹102.**
